# Surface Talent

> Specialist recruitment for UK surface engineering and metal finishing.

Canonical site: https://surfacetalent.co.uk/

## Pages

- [Home](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/): Positioning and proof
- [Clients](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/clients): Hiring / retained search for employers
- [Candidates](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/candidates): Talent pool and career representation
- [Disciplines](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/disciplines): Process lanes (electroplating, anodising, powder coating, heat treatment, thermal spray, PVD/CVD, and more)
- [Jobs](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/jobs): Live vacancies
- [About](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/about): Provenance — sister business of the EMC Surface Technologies group
- [Contact](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/contact): Brief a role or confidential conversation

## Trust and legal

- [Candidate privacy notice](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/candidate-privacy): What candidate information we hold, where it comes from, how AI-assisted assessment works, and candidate rights
- [Fair recruitment and responsible AI](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/responsible-ai): What our AI-assisted assessment does and does not do, and the safeguards
- [Privacy policy](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/privacy): Clients, suppliers and website visitors
- [Cookie policy](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/cookies): This site sets no cookies and carries no analytics or tracking
- [Modern slavery and ethical recruitment](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/modern-slavery): Voluntary policy; candidates never pay a fee to find work
- [Privacy requests](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/privacy-requests): How to access, correct or delete your information
- [Terms of website use](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/terms)
- [Accessibility statement](https://surfacetalent.co.uk/accessibility)
